description.value: Janice Cake Shop is a bakery located in a commercial unit in Richmond, BC, offering vegetarian-friendly baked goods with indoor seating available. It is wheelchair accessible and operates on a cash-only basis. For a touring cyclist, it could serve as a quick food stop, though it is a specialty cake shop rather than a general grocer.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 50m; rack at 85m.
